Name: Trade Contracts(Pelican Exchange)
Author: SHASHFORGE
Description:
Pelican Trade Exchange
A Living, Dynamic Commodity Economy for Stardew Valley
Tired of the Community Center vs. Joja choice being the only "economic" decision your farm ever makes? [b]Pelican Trade Exchange[/b] adds a real, standalone trading economy to the valley — completely independent of Joja and the Community Center — where your farm becomes an actual commercial supplier, not just a shipping bin.
[line]
[heading]🌾 What Makes This Different[/heading]
This isn't another static order board. Every contract is generated dynamically based on the current season, item rarity, and real market demand — and no two weeks look the same.
[list]
[*][b]9 unique trading companies[/b], each with their own personality, item preferences, and payout style — from Pelican Foods' everyday produce runs to the exclusive, high-value contracts offered by the Stardew Export Authority and Ginger Island Trading Co.[/*]
[*][b]Short-Term contracts[/b] — quick, seasonal delivery orders that refresh weekly, with rewards that always beat what you'd get from the shipping bin.[/*]
[*][b]Long-Term contracts[/b] — commit to a multi-week supply agreement (3–8 weeks depending on the company and item), earn a guaranteed weekly payment plus a completion bonus, and get rewarded extra for delivering early. Miss too many weeks, though, and the company will walk away.[/*]
[*][b]Real negotiation[/b] — don't like the terms? Push back. Adjust the requested quantity or the deadline and watch your payout recalculate live, with a real risk that overly aggressive terms get rejected.[/*]
[*][b]Rarity-aware pricing[/b] — common crops get bulk orders, rare and valuable goods get smaller, more precious requests. The economy actually understands what your goods are worth.[/*]
[*][b]Every contract guarantees a real profit[/b] over simply selling in the shipping bin — no more delivery quests that pay worse than just walking to the bin.[/*]
[/list][heading]📦 How to Use[/heading]
[list=1]
[*][b]Open the Trade Exchange[/b] by pressing
[code]L[/code]on your keyboard, anywhere on your farm or in town.[/*]
[*]Browse the [b]Companies[/b] list on the left — each one wants different goods and offers different contract styles.[/*]
[*]Pick [b]Short Term[/b] or [b]Long Term[/b] at the top to browse that company's available orders.[/*]
[*]Click an order to see the full details — items required, payment, and company info.[/*]
[*]Not happy with the terms? Hit [b]Negotiate[/b] to adjust quantity or deadline before accepting.[/*]
[*]Hit [b]Accept Contract[/b], then head to the [b]Active[/b] tab any time to check your progress and deliver items directly from your inventory using the [b]Deliver[/b] button next to each required item.[/*]
[*]Once every item is delivered, hit [b]Schedule Delivery[/b] (or it completes automatically once fulfilled) to collect your payout.[/*]
[/list]That's it — no new buildings, no new NPCs to befriend, no complicated setup. Just open the board and start trading.
[heading]✨ Features at a Glance[/heading]
[list]
[*]9 distinct companies with unique item preferences and personalities[/*]
[*]Fully dynamic, season-aware contract generation — never the same board twice[/*]
[*]Short-Term and Long-Term contract types with different risk/reward profiles[/*]
[*]Live negotiation system with real rejection risk[/*]
[*]Direct inventory-based delivery — no drop boxes, no extra steps[/*]
[*]Rarity-based quantity and pricing so every item feels appropriately valuable[/*]
[*]Guaranteed minimum profit margin on every contract, always better than shipping[/*]
[*]Clean, custom-built UI designed to feel like a natural part of the game[/*]
[/list][heading]⚙️ Installation[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] if you haven't already.[/*]
[*]Download this mod and extract the
[code]PelicanTradeExchange[/code]folder into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Press
[code]L[/code]in-game to open the Trade Exchange.[/*]
[/list][heading]🔧 Compatibility[/heading]
[list]
[*]Requires SMAPI (Stardew Valley 1.6.x)[/*]
[*]Works alongside Content Patcher and most item-adding mods[/*]
[*][b]Multiplayer:[/b] currently host-only — farmhands cannot open or manage the Trade Exchange in this version, to keep contract and economy data safely in sync.[/*]
[/list][heading]Updated Features:
[list]
[*]📈 Reputation-based contract rewards [/*]
[*]⭐ Company reputation tier display [/*]
[*]📅 Season-based progression [/*]
[*]💰 Balanced contract payouts [/*]
[*]🔄 Automatic migration of old contracts [/*]
[*]⏳ Fixed long-term contract expiration [/*]
[*]🎁 Automatic rewards for affected old contracts [/*]
[*]📜 Scrollable Active Contracts [/*]
[*]🏢 Scrollable Company & Orders board [/*]
[*]🖥️ Improved UI and text formatting[/*]
[/list][/heading]
[line]
[b]If you enjoy it, endorse and leave feedback — bug reports and suggestions genuinely shape what comes next.
[/b]Also UI update request also accepted, If you want UI to be updated leave a comment I will try to fix that.
